summary: Namib Minerals filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release providing an operational update on the Mill Expansion Project at its How Mine. The update describes progress on civil works, delivery of mechanical components, completion of factory acceptance tests, and the company's expectation to complete construction and commissioning in H2 2026. No transaction, material definitive agreement, or corporate event triggering special-situations classification is present. This is a routine operational progress report with forward-looking statements, not a special situation.
